policy: Every entry is code that exists only to read or convert names Stave no longer uses, or to replay a rename on another branch. `bun run check:temporary-migrations` fails once package.json reaches removeInVersion; delete the marked blocks, the listed tests and the entry before that release. See AGENTS.md, Temporary Migrations.

migrations.description: Martin sync was removed after 0.33.1. Opening the database drops its leftover martin_sync_outbox table and indexes; the statements are idempotent and run on every open. At expiry, delete the marked blocks; a profile that skipped these releases keeps an orphaned table that nothing reads.

Martin sync was removed after 0.33.1. Settings rehydration deletes the saved martinSync toggles, so the next settings save no longer carries them. At expiry, delete the marked block; a profile that skipped these releases keeps an unused martinSync key that nothing reads.
